name: capnp-ls
description: Cap'n Proto language server guidance for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Install and configure capnp-ls from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Provides Codex guidance for installing capnp-ls, choosing capnp-v1 or capnp-v2 release channels, and configuring project-level .capnp-ls.json import paths. The plugin does not bundle or launch the language server binary.
capabilities: Cap'n Proto language server configuration guidance
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me install and configure capnp-ls for my Cap'n Proto project.
